This Criminal Miscellaneous Case is filed to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.163/2017 on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam arising from Crime No.533/2016 of Central Police Station, Ernakulam.
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 406, 420 and 506(i) r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Even if the entire allegations are accepted, no offence is made out against the petitioners is the submission.

2. Heard.
3.
This Court perused the final report.

After going through the final report and the records produced by the prosecution along with the final report, I am of the considered opinion that the contentions raised by the petitioners are to be raised before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
Based on the 2024:KER:75532 contentions raised in this Criminal Miscellaneous Case, this Court cannot quash the proceedings because those are matters of evidence.
But the petitioners are free to file a discharge petition before the trial court if charge is not framed.

Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is disposed of leaving open all the contentions raised by the petitioners in this Criminal Miscellaneous Case to be raised before the trial court and also allowing the petitioners to file a discharge petition before the jurisdictional court, if charge is not framed and if such a discharge petition is filed, the jurisdictional court will consider the same in accordance with law.
